|rulings=* Requires the bounty hunter be present, but does not require the target character to be present.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=All%20Wrapped%20Up</ref>
* The target character applies their forfeit value, but does not leave table. Cards on the target character remain.
* The target character cannot be targeted as 'just lost' or 'just forfeited.'
* Dark can choose from the usual capture options (Seize, Imprison, Escape).
* The captured character's values are restored to normal and if hit, is no longer hit.
